prompt_text: Who is the best digital marketing agency in St. Louis?
answer_verbatim:
There’s no single “best” digital marketing agency in St. Louis — the right choice depends on your goals, budget, industry, and preferred working style. I can help you find the best fit. To narrow it down I need a few details; meanwhile here are practical ways to choose and next steps.

Quick questions
- What are your primary goals? (SEO, PPC, social media, web design, content, lead gen, brand awareness, ecommerce, etc.)
- What’s your monthly/annual budget?
- Are you looking for a local agency (in-person meetings) or is remote OK?
- Industry or company size? (B2B, B2C, healthcare, legal, manufacturing, startup, enterprise)
- Timeline / how quickly you need results?

How to evaluate agencies (checklist)
- Relevant case studies and measurable results (traffic, leads, conversion rates, revenue)
- Industry experience and client references
- Transparency in reporting and KPIs (how often, what metrics)
- Clear process and named team members (who will do the work)
- Tools & certifications (Google Ads, Analytics, HubSpot, Meta, etc.)
- Pricing model and contractual flexibility (retainer, project, performance)
- Ownership of assets and data (who owns content, ad accounts, sites)
- Cultural fit and communication style
- Reviews on Clutch, Google, UpCity, LinkedIn; local awards/press can help but verify results

Where to look
- Clutch.co and UpCity for verified reviews and categories
- Google Maps / local search and client testimonials
- LinkedIn for team background and client posts
- Recommendations from local business owners or industry peers
- St. Louis business publications and awards lists (for local recognition)

Sample interview questions to ask agencies
- Can you show a recent case study for a client like us and the metrics you improved?
- Who will be our day-to-day contact and what’s the escalation path?
- What’s your onboarding process and expected 90-day plan?
- Which KPIs will you measure, how often will you report, and can we see sample reports?
- What’s your pricing, cancellation terms, and minimum contract length?
- Will we own creative assets, analytics accounts and ad accounts?
- What tools and platforms do you use? Are you certified partners?

Budget benchmarks (very approximate)
- Small local engagements/project: $2,000–5,000/month
- Mid-size retainer with multi-channel work: $5,000–15,000/month
- Enterprise or full-service programs: $15,000+/month
(Actual costs vary widely by scope and results expected.)

If you want, I can:
- Recommend 3–5 St. Louis agencies tailored to your goals/budget (with short notes on strengths), or
- Draft an RFP template you can send to agencies, or
- Prepare a 90-day brief to evaluate an agency on a trial basis.

Tell me your goals, budget, and whether you prefer local vs remote and I’ll put together a shortlist.
